values.note: RV sites $35 a night for York County residents, $50 for non-residents; York County seniors 60+, disabled, active military and county employees $31. Primitive tent sites $21 / $35 / $18. Every reservation adds a $3.00 reservation fee plus tax.

fees.source: https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/1035/Camping-Information ('RV CAMPING RATES: (All reservations are subject to a $3.00 reservation fee and applicable taxes) York County Resident $35 / night ... Non-York County Resident $50 / night'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations up to 13 months ahead on Campspot (linked from the county's Reserve a Campsite page). 'NOT a long-term campground. The maximum length of stay is 14 nights on a campsite.' Check-in 2-9 pm, out by noon; the registering camper must be 21+ and present for the stay; one RV and one tent or two tents, 6 people per RV site.

booking.source: https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/1035/Camping-Information ('camping reservations can be made 13 months in advance'; 'Allison Creek Park is NOT a long-term campground. The maximum length of stay is 14 nights on a campsite') + https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/1041/Reserve-a-Campsite (Campspot link), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/1035/Camping-Information ('RV campsites are paved, and each equipped with water, sewer, electric (50/30/20 amp)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 33 paved full-hookup RV sites and 16 primitive tent sites.

sites.source: https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/1035/Camping-Information ('Allison Creek Park has 33 full hook-up RV campsites and 16 primitive tent sites. RV campsites are paved'), read 2026-10-21

note: York County park on Lake Wylie. --Claude
summary: York County's camping page: fees restructured to the resident base $35 with a +$15/night non-resident surcharge ($50, matching the earlier Campspot read) and the $3 reservation fee; confirmed Campspot booking 13 months ahead, 14-night max, open year-round, 50/30/20 A + water + sewer, 33 RV + 16 tent sites (all now manual). Note trimmed of the site-count/hookup restatement.
